author: _Phyre
body:
Hello! this is my first (kinda) map release (kinda). The YML i need someone to code (I will give credit in my map). So this is my first map to be released (Hopefuly) on Avicus... I think it turned out pretty well, 

Monuments: There are 3 monuments (Monument A, Monument B, Monument C) 
Teams: Blue, and Red | I do not know how many people my map can handle, probably the max is 50v50 min. 30v30... So i'll just say 40v40. The spawn kit is in the Imgur album but, I will tell you:

Armor: Leather Cap, Leather Tunic
Tools/Hotbar: (Slot 1: Stone sword) (Slot 2: Bow) (Slot 3: Diamond Pickaxe) (Slot 4: Stone axe) (Slot 5: 16 Oak log) (Slot 6: 16 Regular Glass) (Slot 7: 16 Cooked Beef) (Slot 8: 4 Torch) (Slot 9: 1 golden apple)
(Slot above golden apple: 64 Arrows) (Iron mines)

Here are the links: 

YML  (HUGE thanks to resepignev For creating the YAML Needed for this map :D)
Images                                                   Resource pack: Huahwi's 64x Defscape edit, PVP ready 1.7
Download (Might not be the Permanent Download, Still need to talk to resepignev)


This map isnt a FULL release, i still need a person to do the YML for me, and when i have chosen someone i will skype you the Map info....  As of now it cant be activated :(...

Estimated time to build: 4.9 Hours.. (Using world edit)
